content.json:
# Azure Control Plane Activity

The Azure activity log: every create, change, delete and action against Azure resources, with the
identity and address that asked for it. **Overview** shows the volume and who is active.
**Sensitive operations** lists the handful of operations that change who has access or what is
logged. **Failures** shows callers that are being refused, which is what exploring with a stolen
credential looks like.

Counts use the final record of each operation (status Success or Failure), so an operation is
counted once.

**Tables read:** `AzureActivity`. A tile or chart for a table you do not collect shows an error; the rest still works.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| summarize Succeeded = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"),
            Failed = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Failure"),
            Callers = dcount(Caller),
            Deletes = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE"),
            RoleChanges = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
                                  and OperationNameValue startswith "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/"),
            Subscriptions = dcount(SubscriptionId)
| project Tiles = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Operations succeeded", "Value", Succeeded),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Operations failed", "Value", Failed),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Callers", "Value", Callers),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Deletions", "Value", Deletes),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Role assignment changes", "Value", RoleChanges),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Subscriptions", "Value", Subscriptions))
| mv-expand Tile = Tiles
| project Metric = tostring(Tile.Metric), Value = tolong(Tile.Value)
content.title: Activity in the time range
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| extend Kind = case(OperationNameValue endswith "/WRITE", "Write",
                     OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE", "Delete",
                     OperationNameValue endswith "/ACTION", "Action",
                     "Other")
| summarize Operations = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Kind
content.title: Successful operations over time, by kind
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and isnotempty(ResourceProviderValue)
| summarize Operations = count() by Provider = toupper(ResourceProviderValue)
| top 12 by Operations desc
content.title: Operations by resource provider (top 12)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Failure")
| summarize Writes = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and OperationNameValue endswith "/WRITE"),
            Deletes = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE"),
            Actions = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and OperationNameValue endswith "/ACTION"),
            Failures = countif(ActivityStatusValue =~ "Failure"),
            Addresses = dcount(CallerIpAddress),
            Subscriptions = dcount(SubscriptionId),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Caller
| top 50 by Writes + Deletes + Actions desc
content.title: Callers
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
let Sensitive = datatable(Operation:string, Meaning:string) [
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/WRITE", "Role assigned",
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEASSIGNMENTS/DELETE", "Role assignment removed",
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ROLEDEFINITIONS/WRITE", "Custom role created or changed",
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/ELEVATEACCESS/ACTION", "Global Administrator elevated to User Access Administrator",
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/LOCKS/DELETE", "Resource lock removed",
    "MICROSOFT.AUTHORIZATION/POLICYASSIGNMENTS/DELETE", "Policy assignment removed",
    "MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/DELETE", "Diagnostic setting deleted",
    "MICROSOFT.INSIGHTS/DIAGNOSTICSETTINGS/WRITE", "Diagnostic setting changed",
    "MICROSOFT.OPERATIONALINSIGHTS/WORKSPACES/DELETE", "Log Analytics workspace deleted",
    "MICROSOFT.SECURITYINSIGHTS/ALERTRULES/DELETE", "Sentinel analytics rule deleted",
    "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/SECURITYRULES/WRITE", "Network security group rule changed",
    "MICROSOFT.NETWORK/PUBLICIPADDRESSES/WRITE", "Public IP address created or changed",
    "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT/VAULTS/ACCESSPOLICIES/WRITE", "Key vault access policy changed",
    "MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/LISTKEYS/ACTION", "Storage account keys listed",
    "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES/RUNCOMMAND/ACTION", "Run Command on a virtual machine",
    "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES/EXTENSIONS/WRITE", "Virtual machine extension installed",
    "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/DISKS/BEGINGETACCESS/ACTION", "Disk export (SAS) started",
    "MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/SNAPSHOTS/WRITE", "Disk snapshot created"
];
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| extend Operation = toupper(OperationNameValue)
| join kind=inner Sensitive on Operation
| project TimeGenerated, Meaning, Caller, Address = CallerIpAddress, Resource = _ResourceId, ResourceGroup, SubscriptionId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 500
content.title: Operations that change access, logging or network exposure
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.title: The same operations, by caller
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success" and OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE"
| where OperationNameValue !startswith "MICROSOFT.RESOURCES/DEPLOYMENTS"
| summarize Deleted = dcount(_ResourceId),
            Types = strcat_array(make_set(OperationNameValue, 6), ", "),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Caller, ResourceGroup
| top 50 by Deleted desc
content.title: Deletions by caller and resource group
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Failure"
| summarize Failures = count(),
            Refused = countif(ActivitySubstatusValue in~ ("Forbidden", "Unauthorized")),
            Operations = dcount(OperationNameValue),
            Examples = strcat_array(make_set(OperationNameValue, 5), ", "),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Caller, Address = CallerIpAddress
| where Refused > 0
| top 50 by Refused desc
content.title: Callers being refused
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Failure") and isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
| summarize Operations = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Caller, Address = CallerIpAddress
| join kind=inner (
    AzureActivity
    | where isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
    | summarize AddressCount = dcount(CallerIpAddress) by Caller
    | where AddressCount > 1) on Caller
| project Caller, Address, Operations, FirstSeen, LastSeen, AddressCount
| order by AddressCount desc, Caller asc, Operations desc
| take 250
content.title: Addresses each caller used
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time range.

content.json: These are the detection rules in this repository for this area (`Detection-rules/` in SentinelWork). A rule with 0 alerts is either not deployed, not enabled, or has had nothing to report in the time range. Alerts are matched to rules by name, so a rule you rename in Sentinel stops being counted here. Incidents are matched by rule name or by the rule's identifier, so they survive a rename.

content.query:
let Rules = datatable(RuleId:string, AlertName:string, RuleSeverity:string, Tactics:string) [
    "AZ-001", "Azure diagnostic settings deleted", "Medium", "DefenseEvasion",
    "AZ-002", "Owner or other privileged Azure role assigned", "High", "Persistence, PrivilegeEscalation",
    "AZ-003", "Many Azure resources deleted by one caller", "High", "Impact",
    "AZ-004", "Run Command executed on a virtual machine", "Medium", "Execution"
];
let AlertCounts = SecurityAlert
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
    | summarize AlertCount = count(), LastAlert = max(TimeGenerated) by AlertName;
Rules
| join kind=leftouter AlertCounts on AlertName
| project RuleId, Rule = AlertName, Severity = RuleSeverity, Tactics, Alerts = coalesce(AlertCount, 0), LastAlert
| order by RuleId asc
content.title: Rule coverage
content.noDataMessage: No rules are defined for this area.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Azure diagnostic settings deleted", "Owner or other privileged Azure role assigned", "Many Azure resources deleted by one caller", "Run Command executed on a virtual machine"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AlertName) by SystemAlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AlertName
content.title: Alerts over time, by rule
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Azure diagnostic settings deleted", "Owner or other privileged Azure role assigned", "Many Azure resources deleted by one caller", "Run Command executed on a virtual machine"]);
SecurityAlert
| where AlertName in (RuleNames)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity, Status,
          Details = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"]), Entities
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Latest alerts
content.noDataMessage: None of these rules raised an alert in the time range.

content.query:
let RuleNames = dynamic(["Azure diagnostic settings deleted", "Owner or other privileged Azure role assigned", "Many Azure resources deleted by one caller", "Run Command executed on a virtual machine"]);
let RuleIds = dynamic(["b6ad0dc6-a84c-5f7c-ab97-0544db24b2e9", "0bce4b20-af76-5f31-ab81-71acb73e92ee", "7ea2fe36-0711-5ede-a437-e54475ef640a", "90fad50a-216f-5e78-8932-d335079ec4f7"]);
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title in (RuleNames) or tostring(RelatedAnalyticRuleIds) has_any (RuleIds)
| extend LabelText = tostring(Labels)
| project CreatedTime, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification,
          AssignedTo = tostring(Owner.assignedTo),
          AgentDisposition = extract(@"soc-agent:(page|queue|auto_close|pending)", 1, LabelText), IncidentUrl
| order by CreatedTime desc
| take 250
content.title: Incidents created by these rules
content.noDataMessage: No incidents from these rules in the time range.
